title: Quarter-wave initialized 16-layer stack at LWIR center wavelength
scientific_hypothesis: Initializing layer thicknesses at quarter-wave optical thickness centered at 9500 nm (midpoint of 8000-11000 nm passband) will provide a better starting point for gradient-based optimization than uniform or random initialization, leading to higher target scores.
design_principle: Quarter-wave stack design with alternating high/low index materials creates constructive interference in transmission band and destructive interference in suppression band. ZnSe (higher index) and ZnS (lower index) form the dichroic pair.
proposed_topology: Air | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | Ge substrate (16 layers total, starting with ZnSe)
soft_objectives: Maximize mean transmittance in 8000-11000 nm band
Minimize mean transmittance in 3000-5000 nm band
manufacturing_considerations: Thickness bounds 200-3000 nm to accommodate quarter-wave scaling at LWIR
theory_basis: Quarter-wave stack principle for dichroic filters
LWIR coating design using matrix formalism
known_risks: May still converge to local optimum
Quarter-wave at single wavelength may not optimize broadband performance
execution_request_english: Optimize a 16-layer dielectric stack on Ge substrate with air incidence. Layer sequence: ZnSe/ZnS alternating, starting with ZnSe (16 layers total). Initialize thicknesses at quarter-wave optical thickness centered at 9500 nm (ZnSe: ~620 nm, ZnS: ~750 nm assuming n_ZnSe≈2.4, n_ZnS≈2.2). Thickness bounds: 200-3000 nm per layer. Optimize for maximum mean transmittance in 8000-11000 nm band and minimum mean transmittance in 3000-5000 nm band. Use gradient-based thickness optimizer with multi-start from quarter-wave baseline. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 8000-11000 nm, 3000-5000 nm. soft objectives: High transmittance in 8000-11000 nm band; Low transmittance in 3000-5000 nm band. behaviors to suppress or avoid: High transmittance in 3000-5000 nm band. manufacturing constraints: Total layer count not exceeding 16.
revision_reason: Changed thickness initialization from uniform/random to quarter-wave at LWIR center wavelength (9500 nm) to provide physics-informed starting point. Expanded upper thickness bound from 2500 nm to 3000 nm to accommodate longer wavelength quarter-wave thicknesses.
